title: ASR Topic Taxonomy (topics.json)
description: The registry's hand-authored topic vocabulary. Every topic a profile claims in scope.topics MUST exist here (unknown_topic); the taxonomy is per-registry by design — energy topics and mycology topics do not belong in one flat list — and each registry maps its topics onto consumer vocabularies (e.g. the pi-forge router) in its export crosswalk, not here. Unlike the manifest this file is NOT regenerable: it encodes human curation, including ties from topics back to the objectives that motivated them.

id.description: Kebab-case topic slug; the value profiles reference.

parent.description: Optional parent topic id for shallow hierarchy; null for top level.

objective.description: Optional tie back to the research objective, contract clause, or question that motivated this topic (generalizes a relevance_objective column).
